question.text: A solid sphere and a solid cylinder of same mass and radius are rolling on a horizontal surface without slipping. The ratio of their radius of gyrations respectively <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>k</mi><mrow><mi>s</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>h</mi></mrow></msub><mo>:</mo><msub><mi>k</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>:</mo><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is _______.

solution.text:
Considering rotational axis as the diametrical axis for sphere and axis of cylinder. Then

K12=25R2 and K22=12R2

∴ K1K2=2/51/2=45

⇒K1K2=25

Comparing it with the given value in the question,

25=2x

∴ x=5
